# Mux Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Mux configuration. The main output is `.mux/rules/project.md`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - mux
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - mux:
      version: full
```

## At a Glance

| Property          | Value                   |
| ----------------- | ----------------------- |
| **Tier**          | Tier 3                  |
| **Main output**   | `.mux/rules/project.md` |
| **Dot directory** | `.mux/`                 |
| **Skills**        | No                      |
| **Agents**        | No                      |
| **Commands**      | No                      |
| **Local files**   | No                      |

## Output Files

| File              | Path                    | Purpose           |
| ----------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------- |
| Main instructions | `.mux/rules/project.md` | Primary rule file |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                            |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single .mux/rules/project.md file |
| `multifile`      | Single .mux/rules/project.md file |
| `full` (default) | Single .mux/rules/project.md file |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support       |
| ------------- | ------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | Not supported |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported |

Native hook reference: <https://promptscript.dev/docs/guides/hooks/>
